aboutPage.title: Neural Network Playground — learn deep learning with your hands, not just slides
aboutPage.lead: This course is a structured path from core ideas (neurons, layers, activations) to practical skills (training, debugging, CNNs and sequences). Everything runs in your browser: lessons, quizzes, a drag-and-drop Network Builder, a classic training playground, and an AI tutor for questions.
aboutPage.whatP1: Neural Network Playground is an interactive deep-learning curriculum. Each module combines short explanations with checkpoints: you read objectives, optionally follow curated videos and links, confirm that you engaged with the materials, pass a chapter quiz, and mark the lesson complete when both parts are done. Progress is tracked so you always know what to do next.
aboutPage.whatP2: Unlike a static PDF or a lone video playlist, the platform ties theory to action. You can sketch architectures in the Network Builder, watch loss and decision boundaries change in the Playground, test understanding in adaptive quizzes, and ask the Tutor AI for clarification in context. The goal is not memorizing jargon—it is building intuition you can reuse in projects and interviews.
aboutPage.helpIntro: Whether you are preparing for coursework, interviews, or self-study, the platform is designed to turn abstract topics into something you can explain and use:
aboutPage.helpB1: Foundations first: clear sequencing from inputs and activations through loss, optimization, regularization, and modern architectures (e.g. CNNs, RNNs).
aboutPage.helpB2: Visible training: see how choices (width, depth, activation, data) affect behavior—not only what the equations say.
aboutPage.helpB3: Honest checkpoints: quizzes and progress metrics highlight weak topics so you study efficiently.
aboutPage.helpB4: Always-on help: the Tutor can explain concepts, walk through quiz reasoning, and suggest what to review next.
aboutPage.helpB5: Portable skills: you leave with vocabulary, intuition, and habits (debugging, validation mindset) that apply beyond this site.
aboutPage.featuresTitle: What you will find on the platform
aboutPage.feat1Text: Chapters ordered from beginner to advanced, with materials, quizzes, and completion rules that keep you honest about what you finished.
aboutPage.feat2Text: Design architectures visually, then open the classic Playground to train on toy datasets and watch boundaries and loss evolve.
aboutPage.feat3Text: Adaptive questions reinforce each topic; your profile summarizes progress, weak areas, and recommended next steps.
aboutPage.feat4Text: Ask questions in plain language, optionally scoped to a module, when you are stuck on a definition or an exercise.
aboutPage.valuesText: We believe deep learning is learnable when feedback is fast: see the graph move, fix the bug, retry the quiz, ask the tutor. That loop is what this platform is built around.
aboutPage.audienceP1: Students and self-learners who want a guided path with hands-on components. Professionals brushing up on fundamentals before interviews or side projects. Educators looking for a browser-based complement to lectures—learners can explore without installing heavy tooling first.
aboutPage.audienceP2: You do not need prior ML employment; basic comfort with math notation and persistence through a technical course helps. If you are completely new to programming, pair this site with a general coding intro—the focus here is neural networks and how they are trained.
aboutPage.ctaLead: Open Learn to follow the catalog, try How it works for the full loop, or take a quiz to see where you stand.
aboutPage.diagramCaption: From lessons and building to training, quizzes, and the AI tutor—then back to your profile for what to do next.

about.title: About Neural Network Playground
about.p1: A learning platform for neural networks and deep learning. Build and train networks visually in the browser, follow a structured learning path with 10 chapters, and take adaptive quizzes that focus on your weak areas.
about.p2: The Network Builder lets you drag nodes, connect layers, and run training with no code. The learning path covers basics (neurons, activation, layers), loss and optimization, CNNs, RNNs, and best practices.
